title: Black Focus
studio_context: The duo's only album, released on Gilles Peterson's Brownswood Recordings; recorded largely live, much of it improvised around grooves.

drum_performances.name: Yussef Dayes
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The record that put him and the London scene on the map: broken beat and jazz-funk played live on an acoustic kit, with the backbeat sliding off 2 and 4 (Strings of Light) and straight-ahead funk drive (Lowrider).

notable_moments.description: Strings of Light: accented snares on the 'a' of 1 and the 'e' of 2 with ghosts all round them.

evidence.note: Studio-context detail (largely live, improvised) is likely rather than verified.
